entities.name: Requested NB-N1 mode DRX parameters
entities.description: Information element used by the UE to request or change UE-specific DRX parameters for NB-N1 mode operation.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that includes the Requested NB-N1 mode DRX parameters IE when it wants to use or change UE-specific DRX parameters.

entities.name: UE wants to use or change UE specific DRX parameters
entities.description: Condition where the UE intends to utilize or modify its specific DRX parameters for NB-N1 mode.

relations.description: The UE includes the Requested NB-N1 mode DRX parameters IE in a message.
The inclusion of the Requested NB-N1 mode DRX parameters IE is conditional on the UE wanting to use or change UE-specific DRX parameters.
